candidate.title: Disconnect unused claude.ai OAuth integrations (no-code, operator action)
candidate.description:
Parent: SAG-2336. See audit Lever A.

Goal: Reduce the 28-entry claudeAiMcpEverConnected set on the claude.ai OAuth account driving Paperclip runners down to an engineering-safe set. This is a board-level operator action only — no agent can disconnect OAuth integrations via API.
